Question 10
?

The number of ants in an anthill increases at a rate that is proportional to the number of ants at the moment. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the number of ants, A, at time t?

a
dAdt=k−A,k>0
b
dAdt=k+A,k>0
c
dAdt=kA,k>0
d
tdAdt=A
e
dAdt=tA
